items.source: This method does not close the input stream.
bytes - the bytes to calculate the digest over
inputStream - the InputStream to calculate the digest over
builder - the string builder to append the digest to
items.translation: builder - 用于追加摘要的字符串构建器

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework; consider Apache Commons Codec for a more comprehensive suite of digest utilities.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部；请考虑使用 Apache Commons Codec 以获得更全面的摘要工具集。

items.source: Append a hexadecimal string representation of the MD5 digest of the given bytes to the given StringBuilder.
items.translation: 将给定字节的 MD5 摘要的十六进制字符串表示追加到给定的 StringBuilder。

items.source: Calculate the MD5 digest of the given bytes.
items.translation: 计算给定字节的 MD5 摘要。

items.source: Return a hexadecimal string representation of the MD5 digest of the given bytes.
items.translation: 返回给定字节的 MD5 摘要的十六进制字符串表示。
